", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u031-r0038", "tag": "p", "text": "“Torres is dead,” Henry told him.", "sha256": "cacbcaac7e3c723f7ff807d315fd0070a6cadd20d49aa43b9f0aa8fa89d22d5e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[2683]", "source_html": "
